items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember him when I was three or four years old. I had an uncle who loved him... I don't remember [where we met].

ctx.x: Do you remember where you met Louis and . . .

Harold. I don‘t remember. Let‘s see, Louis was working with the State Department. Harold was working in the government. I don‘t remember. I can‘t tell you. But this is a long . . . do we have to go that far? Let‘s go on to something else, okay, because I can‘t . . .
Let‘s go on to Olivia‘s Patio Lounge.
